en: Sepia-toned aerial view of a small European town nestled in hilly countryside. In the foreground stands a prominent civic building facing a square, with a clock on its roof. Around it are tightly packed townhouses and narrow streets. Further back, a church with a tall tower and onion-shaped spire rises above the roofs. In the background are wooded hills and farmland. At the bottom margin of the image, a printed caption identifies the town.
